top_signals.title: IDR/USD: Indonesian Rupiah Drops to Record Amid MSCI Concerns, Oil Risks
top_signals.summary: The Indonesian rupiah fell to an all-time low as a stronger dollar and the risk of MSCI Inc. removing the nation’s stocks from its emerging-market indexes cast a pall over Asia’s worst-performing currency.

top_signals.title: Mexican Steel Imports from Asia Fall as More US Supplies Sought
top_signals.summary: Mexico’s crackdown on Asian imports is creating an opening to buy more US-made steel, a top economic official said, a shift that could help advance trade negotiations with the Trump administration.
